en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5697 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Al-Halabi who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who had invoked li'an against his wife while she was pregnant, and her pregnancy was visibly apparent. He denied what was in her womb.
However, after she gave birth, he claimed the child and acknowledged it, asserting that it was his.
Abu Abdullah (as) said: "The child is returned to him, and he inherits from him, and the man is not subjected to flogging because the li'an has already taken place."
